title: The Secret Treasure of Sundarvan
description: Aarav and Meera find an old map and embark on a thrilling quest to discover a hidden treasure buried deep in their village forest.

scenes.description: warm village evening, children gathered around Nanu listening to stories
scenes.visual_prompt: (wide shot:1.3) Indian village evening, children gathered around elderly man, warm lantern light, (storybook cozy:1.4)
scenes.narration: सुनदरवन के जंगल में छुपा है एक राज़ी खजाना।
scenes.subtitle: The Secret

scenes.description: close-up of old weathered map in Aarav’s hands
scenes.visual_prompt: (close-up) old map with faded markings, hands holding it carefully, (storybook antique:1.3)
scenes.narration: आरव को मिला एक पुराना नक्शा, जो खजाने तक ले जाता है।
scenes.subtitle: The Map

scenes.description: Meera and Aarav studying map excitedly under lantern light
scenes.visual_prompt: (medium shot) two children studying old map, warm lantern glow, (storybook cozy:1.3)
scenes.narration: मीरा ने कहा, ‘चलो, खोजते हैं उसे!’

scenes.description: children running through village towards forest at sunset

scenes.narration: जंगल का रास्ता धीरे-धीरे उनके सामने खुल गया।
scenes.subtitle: The Forest Path

scenes.visual_prompt: (medium shot) children with lanterns walking on narrow forest trail, soft ambient light, (storybook magical:1.3)
scenes.narration: लालटेन की रौशनी से उन्होंने आगे बढ़ना जारी रखा।
